whyVoice.headline:
Speaking is faster.
More natural.
More you.
whyVoice.body: Sometimes you say something out loud before you've had time to turn it into what you think you're supposed to say.

product.headline:
Designed for clarity.
Built for reflection.

features.title: One question. One tap. Done.
features.body: A thoughtful question appears each day. Tap, speak, and you're finished in under a minute. No blank page. No pressure.

features.title: Every word you've ever said.
features.body: Browse and revisit your past reflections. Search, filter, and hear how your thinking has shifted over weeks and months.

features.title: See yourself clearly.
features.body: ÉCHO builds a picture of your emotional patterns, recurring themes, and growth arc over time. 8-point persona updated with every entry.

features.title: Six months later, same question.
features.body: Seal your words. ÉCHO returns them when enough time has passed — and shows you who you've become since then.

features.title: Private by design.
features.body: On-device transcription. Encrypted at rest. No tracking. No advertising identifiers. Your voice never leaves your phone.

founder.headline: Why I built ÉCHO
founder.body: ÉCHO began with a simple belief: your own past words can help you understand what you're feeling now. This is the tool I always wished I had.

privacy.headline: Your thoughts stay yours.

pillars.title:
Transcription is
on-device
pillars.body: WhisperKit runs on your iPhone. Your audio is never sent to any server, ever.

pillars.title:
AI insights use
anonymised text only
pillars.body: Pattern insights (Pro) send anonymised reflection text to Gemini — never audio, never your name. You can disable it any time.

pillars.title: Never used to train AI
pillars.body: Your words aren't used to train AI models — not ours, not Google's, not anyone's. This is an architectural constraint, not just policy.

pillars.title: Delete anything, anytime
pillars.body: One tap removes any entry permanently — from your device and iCloud.
